content.short: Lido provides a liquid staking platform for earning interest on crypto across ETH, MATIC, and SOL.
content.description: Launched in December 2020, Lido is a leading liquid staking platform that lets users earn interest on their cryptocurrencies across blockchains. The Lido DAO governs the protocol, including selecting node operators and setting fees, and helps ensure security. When staking assets, users receive a liquid token such as stETH that can be used across DeFi apps and staked for additional yield. Unlike traditional staking, Lido enables continued use of liquid tokens across DeFi. Lido focuses on Ethereum but also supports Solana, Kusama, Polkadot, Polygon, and Terra.
content.meta: Lido provides a liquid staking platform for earning interest on crypto across multiple blockchains. Discover Lido and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: stETH Liquidity Held Its Ground During the KelpDAO Stress Event
resources.tldr: The April 2026 rsETH exploit was a shock Lido did not cause. Market depth got expensive and pricing moved, but stETH kept functioning, which makes this a useful read on second-hand contagion.

resources.title: A New Lido Core Upgrade for Protocol Sustainability and a Leaner Ethereum
resources.tldr: Changes across the staking modules aimed at protocol health and a lighter validator footprint. A good window into how a liquid staking protocol keeps pace with Ethereum's roadmap.
